text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Fan Fest, and a special new shop has opened up at Tracen Academy for the occasion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ting-a-ling!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Welcome.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's a cozy pop-up coffee shop that'll be open for one day only.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Thank you for waiting, Trainer… This is my specially roasted Manhattan blend.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Go ahead, try it…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: There aren't any. It's this serenity that makes the shop so comfortable. What's more…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: No one can find it anyway. Even if they do, the entrance will only lead them straight out through the exit…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It sounds like Manhattan Cafe is distorting the boundaries of space and time. I'm not sure why she opened this shop though…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ting-a-ling!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sniff, sniff… That smells amazing! I just knew there had to be a cafe around here!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whoa, I didn't know this was your place, Cafe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The new customer is Special Week, a cheerful racer from Hokkaido.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hmm, gimme a "Super-Duper Creamy Coffee"!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …O-okay. But… I must ask you, Spe…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: How did you… enter?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Uh… I just smelled something amazing, I guess?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Something… amazing? I see…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe might sound like she's accepted the explanation, but the suspicious look she's giving Special Week says otherwise.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Thank you for waiting, here's your large Viennese coffee. I'll just place it here.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wow, there's so much cream on top! All righty, I'll knock this back, then go give the Fan Fest and my spring races ev'rything I got!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Um… Spe? Which spring races… are you going to enter?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh, you wanna know about my schedule? Well, I got a bunch of ideas, but there's this one race I gotta run in…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: And that's the spring Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: The spring Tenno Sho… I knew it…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe will be running in that race too. Is that somehow related to Special Week showing up at this cafe?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: This must be a sign… Our rivalry is what led you here…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Spe… I'll be racing too…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'm also entering the spring Tenno Sho…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whoa, you're entering too, Cafe? G-guess that means I've got some steep competition, huh.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hrmm. In that case, I'd better put my power-up plan into action right now! Time for my signature move!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: What… signature move?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Cafe! Gimme all the desserts on the menu! And that includes the milk-flavored macaron and the apple custard!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Gimme all ya got!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Is she looking to… boost her stamina? Special Week goes on to polish off everything she asked for, down to the last bite.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I think I'm in trouble…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: No, I have a more pressing concern…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: She scarfed down all that food without a care in the world. I had no idea you could get stronger that way…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I can't lose… I just can't…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This cozy pop-up cafe is open for one day only…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yet the barista in charge has other things on her mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ting-a-ling!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The doorbell rings unexpectedly, and in comes a clamoring crowd of customers.

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: Oh, this has to be the place—the coffee shop Manhattan Cafe opened up!

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: What a lovely atmosphere! And the interior is just as wonderful as you'd expect! Oh, I'm such a big fan of hers.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Oh, um…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yes, it seems that way… But… I wonder how?
choice_data_list: It just goes to show how passionately they were searching.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thanks to her recent efforts, Manhattan Cafe's popularity is starting to soar.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like her fame is what drew in her fans. And…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Gee whiz, this place is as bustling as a hive of bees! There's no way Cafe will be able to manage this shop on her lonesome.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Okey dokey, I'm going to chip in! Boss, we need a lemon squash, a milkshake, and some homemade napolitan spaghetti on the double!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Whoa, hey… I never agreed to any of this. I'm not your butler.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Geez. Don't come crying to me if you get burned. If you know what you're getting into, though… I guess I'll play along.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer… My concept for the cafe… It's…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Well… I suppose it's nice to be popular sometimes. If the alternative is the place staying empty every year…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With so many fans and Umamusume coming to see Manhattan Cafe, the shop is a huge success.
